status: The native Assets composition handoff now writes the acquisition-cost Money snapshot through the Finance-owned public port on the same serializable Holding transaction as the Asset register row. Positive and zero acquisition costs use the configured currency scale and acquired-date confirmed USD quote; missing scales/rates fail closed; the snapshot is bounded, read back and rolled back with the owner unit.

scope.composition: FinanceAssetCost now calls lock_asset_acquisition_money_sources, prepare_asset_acquisition_money and persist in the Asset HTTP command transaction. Stable composition constructs it with the selected Company and shared clock.
scope.finance: The existing Finance-owned asset_acquisition_money port retains exact scale, effective-date quote selection, latest fallback, USD conversion, source locks, receipt bounds and current-evidence checks. No Finance business logic was duplicated in Assets.
scope.failure: Persistence failures map to ASSET_ACQUISITION_COST_UNAVAILABLE; Finance business errors pass through. A missing scale/rate or changed source fails before the Asset row, and a later failure rolls back both effects.
scope.notClaimed: Authenticated Assets browser journeys remain blocked by the keyed work-role chooser. This slice adds no new Workflow/Audit/Outbox semantics; the Asset command unit retains them.

verification.composition: cargo test -p erpx-service --locked --test asset_cost_composition_postgres --features existing-business: 1/1 passed. The test migrates a disposable PostgreSQL database, configures THB scale 2 and a confirmed 36.5 THB/USD rate, writes the acquisition snapshot for a 101-minor asset dated 2026-01-15, asserts the exact date/scale/amount/rate/fallback/capture timestamp, rolls back the unit and confirms zero snapshot rows.
verification.assets: cargo test -p erpx-server-assets --locked --test asset_http_postgres: 5/5 passed (register/decimal errors, workspace/detail scope, origin/idempotency/replay, placement/condition/retirement).
verification.compile: cargo check -p erpx-service --locked and cargo check --workspace --locked passed.
verification.format: The new test file and changed composition files were checked with rustfmt; unrelated dirty worktree files were not reformatted.

limitations: The committed composition file intentionally carries only the Finance handoff change. Unrelated concurrent Assets worktree edits remain unstaged and are preserved.
Browser acceptance is blocked by the keyed work-role chooser, the same blocker as the Commerce save slice.
nextAction: Retry authenticated Assets desktop/mobile registration with a positive cost when the keyed work-role selection path is restored; continue with the next dependency-ready non-browser bundle.
